hero.en: Hidden volume is running hot in 4 names — quiet-accumulation footprints lead distribution, 4 to 0.
hero.zh: 暗池成交在4只个股中异常活跃——悄然吸筹的痕迹以4比0领先派发。

read.en: Big blocks trading in the dark while short-marked selling stays light — the footprint left when institutions build a position quietly.
read.zh: 大额成交在暗池进行，而卖空标记偏轻——机构悄然建仓时留下的痕迹。

read.en: Heavy dark volume with short-marked selling building faster than usual for the name — the footprint of quiet distribution or a short campaign.
read.zh: 暗池成交沉重，且卖空标记的增速快于该股常态——悄然派发或做空行动的痕迹。

read.en: Off-exchange share is running well above each name's own baseline, but short-marked selling is mixed — something is happening, direction not yet readable.
read.zh: 场外占比明显高于各自基线，但卖空标记方向不一——有异动，但方向尚不明朗。

read.en: Heavy dark footprint and short-marked selling backing off — a quiet-accumulation lean.
read.zh: 暗池痕迹沉重、卖空标记回落——偏向悄然吸筹。
